item.title: Welcome to My Digital Playground 🛠️
item.description:
Hey, I’m Aitana 👋

Welcome to my corner of the internet! I’m a developer, tinkerer, and proud code nerd who decided to stop keeping my projects hidden in GitHub repos and start sharing them with the world.

This site is my digital playground—a place where I showcase the things I build, write about tech (and occasionally break things just to fix them again 😉), and reflect on my journey in software development.
